name: DS Cluster D07: Economic Indicators (FRED + EIA)
description: Tests: common_indicators enum, economic_indicators by FRED ID, EIA route+series, ffill pattern, yield curve spread.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D07: Economic Indicators
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === CURATED ENUM (common_indicators) ===
cpi_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()
cpi = ffill(cpi_src.result)

fed_funds_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
fed_funds = ffill(fed_funds_src.result)

# === YIELD CURVE SPREAD ===
y10_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
y2_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury2Y)()
spread_10y2y = ffill(y10_src.result) - ffill(y2_src.result)

# === ARBITRARY FRED SERIES (by ID) ===
payems_src = economic_indicators(series_id="PAYEMS")()
nfp = ffill(payems_src.result)

walcl_src = economic_indicators(series_id="WALCL")()
fed_bs = ffill(walcl_src.result)

# === EIA ENERGY SERIES ===
crude_src = economic_indicators(series_id="WCESTUS1", eia_route="petroleum/stoc/wstk", eia_data_frequency=EiaFrequency.Weekly)()
crude_stocks = ffill(crude_src.result)

# === WTI CRUDE (curated enum) ===
wti_src = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.WTICrude)()
wti = ffill(wti_src.result)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Yield Curve 10Y-2Y Spread",
    category="Macro",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Spread", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spread_10y2y)

xy_lines(
    title="CPI vs Fed Funds",
    category="Macro",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="CPI", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Fed Funds", color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cpi, fed_funds))

xy_lines(
    title="Crude Oil Stocks (EIA Weekly)",
    category="Energy",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Crude Stocks", color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=crude_stocks)
